paper_title: Feasibility and flexibility analysis of black-box processes Part 1: Surrogate-based feasibility analysis

quantitative_outcomes.notes: This paper is a work in chemical engineering and process modeling. It develops a computational algorithm for 'surrogate-based feasibility analysis' of black-box processes. The primary case study is a physical process (pharmaceutical roller compaction), not a chemical synthesis. The paper has no direct relevance to cross-coupling reaction optimization.
